children: , the world's largest pureplay adhesives provider, today announced Bin Dasmal General Trading Co. and Huhtamaki as recipients of its 2026 Customer Innovation Award.

From reducing plastic in food packaging to improving the durability of critical infrastructure, this year's H.B. Fuller Customer Innovation Award winners are solving some of the world's most complex manufacturing challenges.

The annual awards recognize customers who have developed solutions delivering measurable advances in sustainability, safety, performance or operational efficiency. Winners are selected based on innovation, market impact, technical achievement and successful collaboration with H.B. Fuller teams.

“The most meaningful breakthroughs happen when great ideas meet deep technical expertise and trusted collaboration,” said CEO Celeste Mastin. “Our customers are solving some of the world's most important challenges, from reducing material use in packaging to improving infrastructure resilience. We are proud to recognize these innovations and the partnerships that helped bring them to life.”

The innovations recognized this year span diverse industries but share a common objective: applying science, engineering and collaboration to solve real-world challenges and make products and systems more sustainable, efficient and reliable.

title: Fuller Gains on Innovation Award
